user.title: Sign in to Furbo
user.description: Enter the email and password you use in the Furbo app.

mfa.title: Verification code
mfa.description: Furbo emailed a verification code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing in.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Furbo
reauth_confirm.description: Your Furbo session expired. Enter your password to sign in again.

reconfigure.title: Update Furbo credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the email and password for this Furbo account.

error.invalid_mfa: That code was rejected. Check the email again, or start over to get a new one.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Furbo cloud. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Furbo account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different Furbo account than this entry.

init.title: Furbo options
init.description: How often to poll the Furbo cloud, and whether to poll the pet calendar for events and daily activity. The next pages cover each camera's live video and local bridge.

camera.title: Live video and controls for {name}
camera.description: Furbo streams and takes commands over a proprietary P2P protocol that Home Assistant cannot speak directly. Run the Furbo P2P bridge on a machine on the camera's LAN: publish its video through go2rtc and enter the RTSP URL, and run its HTTP API (furbo_p2p.py serve) and enter that URL for camera controls. Leave a field empty to skip it.

data_description.stream_url: For example rtsp://192.168.1.10:8554/furbo. Accepted schemes: rtsp, rtsps, http, https. Creates the camera entity.
data_description.bridge_url: For example http://192.168.1.10:8791. Enables camera power, volume, night vision, bark sensitivity, tracking, pan and treat toss.
data_description.bridge_token: The value given to furbo_p2p.py serve --token, if any.

error.invalid_stream_url: Enter an rtsp://, rtsps://, http:// or https:// URL, or leave the field empty.
error.invalid_bridge_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL, or leave the field empty.

bridge_command_failed.message: The Furbo bridge did not accept the command: {error}
